scope: Existing raw artifacts, traces, native network payloads, source and probe hashes; no browser launch, product run, repository modification or GitHub message
verdict: Agree with the bounded browser defect findings for #174 and the two rejection/input-generation findings for #173. These remain product blockers on the unchanged relevant source in 3a48cf5, not external-only acceptance conditions.

source_identity.scope_limit: Source-equivalent findings transfer to 3a48cf5; this is not a claim that the browser scenarios or full regression were rerun at 3a48cf5.

integrity.served_javascript_limit: Playwright traces omit app.js and space-workspace.js response bodies. Their HTTP 200 lengths, runtime version and session match the recorded fresh runtime and source files; independent historical GET-body hashing is unavailable. Do not claim it was performed.

findings.observation: Actual native proj 0 0 0 711 reply was held at response.json; user controls switched edit→view→B edit. B 712 at token 5 had 5 handles in 1 group. After A release and settled A/B draw promises, B still had the same tool, id and token but 0 handles/groups. Full before/after dumps are byte-identical in each viewport.
findings.cause_assessment: Matches drawEditHandles' post-await stale-token branch calling global previewClear. The probe wraps the original function and waits for its entire promise; it does not manufacture projection data or erase handles.

findings.classification: confirmed real-browser newer-input loss on native rejection
findings.coverage: main and face inspector, each at 1400px and 390px
findings.observation: Submitted 2000 gets the real native hole-outside-shortened-outline rejection. While pending, 5151 is typed in the original still-connected input. After the complete handler settles, value is 4000 and full World remains unchanged.
findings.cause_assessment: Matches resetting connected inp.value to inp.defaultValue without checking whether a newer edit happened. Native rejection is an intentional valid negative fixture, not a product defect itself.

findings.classification: confirmed browser rejection-state defect under explicit renderer injection
findings.coverage: main and face inspector, each at 1400px and 390px
findings.observation: During the same real native rejection, the probe explicitly invokes the actual product renderer and verifies the original input disconnected. After release/settlement, rejected 2000 remains visible in its replacement while model/defaultValue stays 4000 and full World is unchanged.
findings.limit: The product renderer and DOM behavior are real. This evidence does not establish a particular normal user action that triggers that redraw; retain the explicit fault-injection label.

separate_controls.replacement_new_value: 5151 survives visually but a second trusted change event sends an actual native boundary mutation and persists 5151. Full dump changes. This cannot certify an uncommitted draft was preserved.
separate_controls.success_sibling: 4200 commits successfully, but the supposedly unsent 4242 sibling also produces a second trusted change/native mutation and persists. The sibling-preservation assertion fails.
separate_controls.disposition: Keep these as distinct observed extra-commit behaviors requiring event/ownership cause review. Do not count them as additional instances of the two rejection bugs, or claim the probe already established their exact root cause.

preconditions_and_probe_revisions.reviewed_changes: fresh-runtime/HTTP checks, width-only selection, normal Escape drawer close, and recognizing the visible inline inspector. Scenario fixtures and behavioral assertions were unchanged across the executed revisions.
preconditions_and_probe_revisions.hash_statement: Probe revisions differ; each executed source matches its own receipt and trace. Do not call all rounds the current probe hash.

next_action: Existing single app.js owner fixes ownership of async writes/cleanup and input edit generations, then repeats the bounded probes and required candidate CDP/Space regressions. Source-only bhit/drag/uvMap-cache concerns remain unverified browser paths.
